title: Playing Pensacola halls and the Belmont Theater vaudeville
summary: Halls, parks and the Belmont Theater where she accompanied vaudeville acts alone on piano.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: What kinds of places in Pensacola did you play, say, do you recall?
Yeah, I played at the hall there, the Coral Street Hall. They had halls there and parks there, on the water.
Was there a theater there that you played, do you remember?
Yeah, there was a Belmont Theater I played there, when they had those shows come through there, vaudevilles at that time.
What kind of shows did you play for at the theater?
Well in the vaudevilles, you know they had people that sing and dance, you know, act like that. Vaudevilles they sing and act, and I'd play any piano for them.
Was there a band or were you just playing the piano?
